'''2007 Corellia Regionals Rick Zuchowski LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rick Zuchowski]] at [[2007 Corellia Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Rick Zuchkuski
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
